audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven full-layer rows disagreed with content win[]: full read Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Skill/Neeko/Skill/Skill against win[] Akali/Akali/Neeko/Neeko/Akali/Akali/Akali.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches win[] exactly and the matchup wins 54.35% over 1310 games. The full layer was rendering the opposite answer on rows 1, 2 and 6.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side=Akali, [2..3]=Neeko, [4..6]=Akali — the whole chart proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never named a single Neeko ability, and spikes[1]/spikes[3] called Pop Blossom a root ultimate.
audit.why: Pop Blossom knocks up and then stuns on landing; it does not root. The root is Tangle-Barbs (E).
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns used: Blooming Burst 9-7s/800, Shapesplitter 16-12s, Tangle-Barbs 12-10s/1000, Pop Blossom 120-90s/600.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page was built on "his combo needs a target — the shroud deletes the targeting". Nothing Neeko casts is target-locked.
audit.why: Blooming Burst is a ground seed, Tangle-Barbs roots everything it passes through, Pop Blossom damages and stuns nearby enemies on landing. None of them select a target, so Twilight Shroud's untargetability does nothing against her damage — it only denies vision. Second unstated interaction: Tangle-Barbs becomes larger, faster and roots longer once it kills a unit or passes a champion, so hiding behind a dying wave UPGRADES the root instead of dodging it — the old advice said the opposite. Third: Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised, so a disguised Neeko has no visible wind-up tell.
audit.corrected: Dodge on foot, not behind minions; treat the shroud as concealment, not immunity; account for every ally silhouette before grouping.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere despite three sequencing cues in the packet.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs at 10-12s is the punish clock; the old text just said "check it".
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[2].d now state the 10s window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko addressed as "his" in tldr, winCon and report[0]/[1].

edits.before: His combo needs a target — the shroud deletes the targeting. Bait the rotation, vanish, and counter through the smoke.
edits.after: Nothing in her kit needs a target, so smoke hides you but never saves you — dodge Tangle-Barbs on foot, then punish the 10s gap.

edits.before: Make his burst hit smoke, then erase him in the cooldown silence. Tangle-Barbs (Root) is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Dodge the root on foot, then erase her in the 10-second silence after it. Tangle-Barbs is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.

edits.before: Neeko wins by landing Tangle-Barbs (Root), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Neeko wins by rooting you with Tangle-Barbs, blooming Q twice on the hold, and landing Pop Blossom out of a disguise.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Check it before every step-up. - W Twilight Shroud is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 10-12s, 1000 range, and it roots longer once it has killed a minion — dodge it in the open. - Blooming Burst: 7-9s and it blooms twice on you. - Pop Blossom: 90-120s, and the wind-up is invisible while she is disguised.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Carry by deleting her before Pop Blossom — it needs you within 600 units, so kill her at the edge of the fight.

edits.before: If Neeko gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Tangle-Barbs (Root) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Neeko gets a kill, treat every ally silhouette as her — the disguise breaks only on damaging spells or CC. Two kills: farm at Q range, ward the sides, and fight only when her R is down.

edits.before: The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs grows and roots longer after it kills a minion — dodge it in the open, not behind a dying wave.

edits.before: Neeko spends Tangle-Barbs (Root) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Neeko spends Tangle-Barbs on the wave — that is a clean 10-second window, so take it immediately.

edits.before: Track Neeko’s Tangle-Barbs (Root): The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Tangle-Barbs: nothing she casts is target-locked, so the shroud hides you without saving you from the root, the Q bloom, or Pop Blossom.

edits.before: Neeko's disguise and burst combo start punishing predictable engages hard once she hits level 3 with a full Q-W-E rotation.
edits.after: From level 3 her Tangle-Barbs root into a double Blooming Burst punishes any predictable step-up, and the root returns every 11s.

edits.before: Your R lets you close distance and burst her down before her own R can root and chain your team, if you strike first.
edits.after: Your R closes on her before Pop Blossom lands — it only reaches 600 units, so kill her from outside that circle.

edits.before: Neeko threatens teamfight-swinging root ults, but 1v1 your all-in still kills her quickly if you engage before she sets up.
edits.after: Pop Blossom knocks up then stuns the group, and the wind-up is hidden while she is disguised — never stack near an unaccounted ally.

edits.before: Neeko: level 3 gives Neeko a full burst rotation that can out-trade Akali if she engages first.
edits.after: Neeko: level 3 Tangle-Barbs into a double Blooming Burst out-trades anything Akali has.

edits.before: Akali: level 6 gives Akali a faster engage that can burst Neeko down before her own ult matters.
edits.after: Akali: level 6 the R kills Neeko before Pop Blossom's 600-unit circle can ever land on you.

notes: The page was built on a false premise — that Twilight Shroud's untargetability blanks Neeko's combo. None of Blooming Burst, Tangle-Barbs or Pop Blossom selects a target, so the shroud denies vision only. Also reversed the "sidestep the root behind minions" line: Tangle-Barbs upgrades when it kills a unit, so minions make it worse, not better. Templated fields left alone for lack of a Neeko-specific fact: breakdown.wave, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.late. Unverified: whether Twilight Shroud's reveal-on-stealth property exposes Neeko's Inherent Glamour disguise, and whether entering the shroud mid-flight causes Tangle-Barbs to pass through — the kit text answers neither and I did not research them. | COHERENCE: 2 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
